name: org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin
description: Bindex Maven Plugin is a Java 17 Maven plugin for generating and registering Bindex metadata in Maven projects and multi-module reactors. It integrates Maven's project, session, settings, dependency-resolution, and base-directory context with Machai Ghostwriter workflows. The reactor-wide bindex and register goals run once for a build and can be invoked without a Maven project; bindex-per-module and register-per-module run for each bound Maven module. Generation delegates to the bindex Machai Act and registration delegates to bindex/register. Workflow configuration supports an optional configuration file, AI model selection, supplemental instructions, excluded paths, Maven settings server credentials, and arbitrary action parameters. The plugin is intended for Maven-based library and application teams that want repeatable Bindex metadata generation and registry publication from command-line commands or lifecycle-bound plugin executions.

features.name: bindex
features.description: Runs the bindex Machai Act once for the Maven reactor. Use this aggregator goal to generate a single Bindex metadata result for a complete build.

examples.description: Invokes the installed plugin's reactor-wide generation goal from a Maven project directory.

features.name: bindex-per-module
features.description: Runs the bindex Machai Act for the current Maven project. Bind it when every module in a reactor requires its own Bindex metadata generation execution.

examples.description: Invokes the module-scoped generation goal for Maven projects in the active build.

features.name: register
features.description: Runs the bindex/register Machai Act once for the reactor to register generated Bindex metadata with the configured registry.

examples.description: Invokes one reactor-wide registration workflow after metadata is available.

features.name: register-per-module
features.description: Runs the bindex/register Machai Act in each module context, making module-specific metadata and Maven configuration available to registration.

examples.description: Invokes module-scoped registration for the projects participating in the active Maven build.

customizations.name: Ghostwriter workflow parameters
customizations.description: All goals accept Maven-injected workflow settings including gw.config, gw.model, gw.instructions, gw.excludes, genai.serverId, and a params map for action-specific values. Maven settings server entries can provide credentials without placing secrets in the project POM.

examples.description: Selects a workflow model and a Maven settings server that supplies credentials for a reactor-wide generation run.

examples.title: Generate Bindex metadata for a Maven reactor
steps: Add org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.4.2 to the build plugins section, or invoke it with fully qualified Maven coordinates.
Optionally configure a Maven settings.xml server and select it with genai.serverId when the selected workflow needs credentials.
Run mvn org.machanism.machai:bindex-maven-plugin:1.4.2:bindex from the reactor root.
The aggregator goal delegates to the bindex Machai Act once for the reactor.

examples.title: Generate and register metadata for each module
steps: Configure the plugin in a parent POM execution with the bindex-per-module goal.
Run the Maven lifecycle or invoke bindex-per-module so Maven supplies each module project context.
After generation, invoke register-per-module using the same plugin version.
The per-module registration goal delegates to the bindex/register Machai Act for each module.
